Name: Luny's Recolors of Bog's Mushroom Trees
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]
I love Bog's designs, and I'm so happy she gave me permission to recolor these! My personal style is very colorful and pastel, so these fit my farm so well! ^.^ They use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], so you can mix and match the colors however you want!

[b]Mushroom Tree design by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/about-me?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url][/b]. It's originally part of her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25720]Witchy Foliage[/url] pack. Check her profile for lots of amazing witchy mods for your farm! ^-^



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]
[center]Download and unzip the mod file.
Move the folder "[AT] Bog's Mushroom Tree Recolors by Luny" into your StardewValley/mods folder.
Done!
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures [/url]﻿to work! Check it's mod page for how to apply new textures.[/center]
